newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC continues its study of nickel smelter.
newsitem.headline: WMC continues its study of nickel smelter.

text.p: Australian nickel producer WMC Ltd said on Friday it would continue to assess damage to its Kalgoorlie nickel smelter, which was shut down on Sunday after part of a furnace roof collapsed.
"We're still assessing the damage," A WMC spokesman said.
He said WMC had not declared force majeure on any nickel sales but declined to comment on whether WMC was considering doing so at a later date.
A 30 day shutdown would reduce nickel matte production by about 7,000-8,000 tonnes, WMC has said.
Between July and December 1996, the smelter produced 58,651 tonnes of nickel matte, containing 39,858 tonnes of nickel metal.
About 40 percent of the matte produced at the smelter is sold directly to customers, with the remaining 60 percent further processed at WMC's Kwinana refinery near Perth.
